text:
jamie-partners: Heads-up — final runway sync for Marketplace listing + joint GTM. Need press assets, L10n, SI oncall, and staging slot confirmed. Embargo 2026-04-01 16:00 PT.

nina-marketing: Pinged press ops doc, landing copy is in Drive (owners have edit). Waiting legal sign-off on partner quotes.

todd-legal: Can approve partner quote A and B by EOD if edits are minor. Paste final wording here or tag me.

lina-localization: We still need Spanish + German hero & CTA strings; ETA tomorrow 12:00 PT. Missing partner badge alt text.

raj-si: SI runbook ready, attaching link in the ops doc. Day-of on-call: me + aya. Will run partner integration smoke tests.

aya-ops: Confirmed I'll be oncall 07:00-19:00 PT day-of. Can take incident lead for partner triage.

mike-ops: Staging cutover slot available 2026-03-31 22:00 PT. Need migration playbook steps added to runbook.

deploy-bot: cutover window created: `cutover/4311234567` (owner: mike-ops).

jamie-partners: Action list for owners: - nina: get legal OK + lock embargo - lina: finish L10n + alt text - raj/aya: oncall confirmation + SI tests - mike: finalize cutover runbook + smoke cmds - partner-team: provide logo variants

nina-marketing: Locking embargo only after legal confirms. Press release outline I will share by 10:30 PT.

todd-legal: Uploaded redlines -> `https://drive/release_redlines_4311.docx`. Minor wording tweak to partner quote 2 (approved if changed).

lina-localization: Uploaded translations to `/l10n/marketplace_4311/`. Added alt texts for hero and partner badges.

raj-si: Added SI triage snippet to runbook. Quick rollback command example: ``
./si_rollback.sh --stage=staging --timeout=5m
``

jamie-partners: Nice. Partner logo variants? @partner-team please confirm SVG + PNG by EOD.

partner-team: Sending assets now (SVG + 2x PNG + brand sheet). Dropping in the drive folder. :white_check_mark:

aya-ops: Day-of checklist (short): `1) verify CDN origin; 2) confirm certs; 3) smoke test endpoints; 4) monitor error budget`. I'll run smoke tests +15 after cutover.

mike-ops: Added smoke test commands to runbook and automated smoke job `ci/smoke-marketplace`. Will kick at +15.

jamie-partners: Good. Current blockers: legal final sign-off (todd) and any L10n gaps. Re-check tomorrow 09:00 PT. If blocker remains, escalate to exec oncall. Thanks everyone :rocket:

nina-marketing: Noted, will update here once locked.

partner-team: One small ask — can we get the partner quote text as a plain paragraph (no blockquote) for localization?

todd-legal: Fine with paragraph format.

jamie-partners: Closing note — please keep notifications on for this thread the next 48h. I'll run the 09:00 PT check-in. :eyes:
